title: Sell without stock
intro: No stock? No problem. You can sell products from suppliers and keep the profit.

steps.caption: Find products
steps.vo: Open Find products. Each product shows what it costs, the price you sell at, and what you keep.

steps.caption: Check the supplier
steps.vo: Tap a product to see the supplier, their rating, and their checks. Choose Dropship or Wholesale.

steps.caption: Put it in your shop
steps.vo: Tap Put it in my shop. When a customer buys, the supplier sends it, and you keep the difference.

outro: Start with a few products your customers already love.
